## 部分落地 + 呈裁 · 项 3 · `domain:skills#1` · `session_01ADHkmSrRBdu9MdC6fc33Uu` · 2026-10-27T12:02Z

Release: items 1–2 landed in PR #26651 (merge commit `079deea82`, `Part of #26527`); item 3 remains and needs the maintainer's word, so this card moves `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision` in this act and the seat's assignee comes off. ⛔ Not a claim.

**一句话问题:** 一个只在运行时代码里收窄已发布接受集的 PR(不碰 spec、不碰受管文本),今天的契约复审只核「收窄是否申报对」,不问「这次收窄本身对不对」;要不要让它也做一次设计判断(④)?

**背景:** 契约复审的 ④ 设计判断现只挂在 schema 面与受管规则面(`contract-review.md` L30;`record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `REVIEW_FACES` 里 `fullReview: true` 只有 `schema`、`rules`)。面按 schema → rules → declaration 解析,所以碰到 `packages/spec/src/**` 或任一受管路径的收窄 PR 已经带 ④;只有「收窄只发生在运行时包(如 `packages/objectql`)」时落到 narrowing 面,不带 ④。

**Governing text:** SKILL.md〈升级与决策〉基本裁决原则:「声明而未兑现是实现缺口,补实现或退役,⛔ 不在消费端收窄」;`contract-review.md` L30:「④ 设计判断只欠 schema 与 governed 规则文本两面」。
**协议声明:** 不改元数据协议;只改复审流程文本与模板(Tier S `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`)。
**前提(re-check):** `grep -n "fullReview" scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` → 只有 schema、rules 为 true;`sed -n 30p .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` → 「只欠 schema 与 governed 规则文本两面」。

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知后果 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** ④ 也挂 narrowing 面 | narrowing 面 `fullReview: true`,L30 改一行,两条自测 pin 翻转 | 只在运行时收窄已发布行为的 PR,复审会对照 spec 问「这次收窄是不是在消费端偷偷砍掉了一个已声明的能力」 | skills 车道 · 1 PR · 先例 PR #26651(+22/−12)、PR #26514 |
| **B** 维持现状 | 不动 | 这类 PR 只核申报是否写对,收窄本身对不对没人判 | 0 |

**业务含义:** A 好比「改了合同条款的执行细则,也要法务看一眼条款本身」;B 是「只看签字栏填没填」。

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 不新增面、不新增门禁,只把已有的 ④ 延到一个缺口面;正好落在「⛔ 不在消费端收窄」这条基本原则最容易被违反的地方(spec 未动、运行时先收窄)。B 让这条原则在该面无人检查。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天撞上的是复审席自己(#25765 复审里实测 narrowing 面是唯一不带 ④ 的面);仅运行时收窄的 PR 数量未实测。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 让 AI 写的「运行时偷偷收窄」被响亮问到;B 下这类收窄只要申报写对就静默通过。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 不是新门禁,是现有复审多一节;代价是该面复审多读几分钟。B 零成本。
Prior rulings read: #25765 full-review order (owner's 「或者至少」 floor, cited on this card); further search unresolved.

**推荐:A。** 只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否(②未实测只影响频次,不影响方向)。置信缺口:仅运行时收窄 PR 的真实频率未测。B 不取:它让基本原则在最易违反的面上无人把关。
**裁后执行:** A ⇒ 本卡回 `pm:queue`,skills 席派一张 S 卡(一 PR:`REVIEW_FACES` narrowing 加 `fullReview: true`、L30 改写、自测 pin 翻转,Tier S,契约复审档复核)。B ⇒ 本卡关 not planned,理由引裁决。

Faces resolve schema → rules → declaration, so the narrowing face is reached only by a PR that narrows a published accept set in runtime code alone, touching neither `packages/spec/src/**` nor a governed path.
- Half-state: `needs-user-decision` alone; the ruling's stroke returns it to `pm:queue` (A) or closes it (B).
- Facets (the seat's block, re-read): ① A extends the existing ④ to the one face where SKILL.md's principle 「声明而未兑现是实现缺口 … ⛔ 不在消费端收窄」 is most easily broken (spec untouched, runtime narrowed first); no new face, no gate. ② the reviewing seat hit it on #25765; the frequency of runtime-only narrowings is unmeasured. ③ A makes an AI's quiet consumer-side narrowing a question the review asks aloud; B passes it when the declaration line is spelled right. ④ one flag, one line, two self-test pins; a few more minutes per such review.
- The seat agrees with **A**. Not B (the principle goes unchecked on the face where it matters). Workload: skills · 1 PR · XS (Tier S, `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`; precedent PR #26651 +22/−12).
Prior rulings read: #25765 full-review order (the owner's 「或者至少」 floor), PR #26514; thread: 6441389321.

Ruling: batch #412 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「A：④ 也挂 narrowing 面」 2026-10-27T12:36Z

Director seat, summon #52 (`session_01ADHkmQr732toX135tyo5zs`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer chose option A on the decision card in the seat's project thread — the four-facet analysis is 6441389321 (`domain:skills#1`, 2026-10-27T12:02Z), which recommended A; this seat recommended A too.

**Ruled:** item ④ (design judgment) of the contract-review record is owed on the narrowing face as well — a PR that narrows a published accept set in runtime code alone, touching neither `packages/spec/src/**` nor a governed path, gets the same ④ the schema and rules faces get: read against the spec on `origin/main`, does this narrowing take away a declared capability at the consumer, or is it the spec's own refusal made real.

**Workload of the chosen letter** (from the card's analysis table): skills lane · 1 PR · precedent PR #26651 (+22/−12) and PR #26514 — `REVIEW_FACES.narrowing` gains `fullReview: true` in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, `contract-review.md` L30 is reworded to name three faces, two self-test pins flip; Tier S, reviewed at the contract-review tier.

**After the ruling:** this card returns to `pm:queue` (the `needs-user-decision` label comes off in the seat's next stroke, after this record); items 1–2 are already on `main` via #26651. The skills lane picks it as one S PR; the card closes on that PR's landing.
